AUTO_TRACK/1.item_text: User can select a visible target.
AUTO_TRACK/1.evidence: the candidate list carries both people and the click that names one is accepted with a reason on the page

AUTO_TRACK/2.item_text: Selected target has persistent runtime identity.
AUTO_TRACK/2.evidence: selection is held by UUID across frames and mode changes; display indices are reused, identifiers are not

AUTO_TRACK/3.item_text: AUTO_TRACK automatically starts tracking selected target when visible.
AUTO_TRACK/3.evidence: a replayed session goes select -> ACQUIRE -> TRACKING without any further command

AUTO_TRACK/4.evidence: clear_target leaves the loop at WAIT_TARGET with intent=hold and no selection

AUTO_TRACK/5.item_text: Selected target not visible => hold after bounded coast.
AUTO_TRACK/5.evidence: a lost target runs COASTING then LOST_HOLD then WAIT_TARGET on the configured timings

AUTO_TRACK/6.evidence: during a dropout the loop holds the last line of sight rather than inventing frames (§58)

AUTO_TRACK/7.evidence: one clear candidate inside the reacquisition window is followed again without a new selection

AUTO_TRACK/8.item_text: Ambiguous reacquisition does not silently choose another target.
AUTO_TRACK/8.evidence: two plausible candidates inside the window produce no target stealing and an event naming why

AUTO_ROAM/1.item_text: Controller scans a configured safe envelope autonomously.
AUTO_ROAM/1.evidence: the sweep runs inside the named region and telemetry says which end it is heading for

AUTO_ROAM/3.item_text: Roam region remains inside v1 safe envelope.
AUTO_ROAM/3.evidence: a roam region that crosses the soft travel is refused at load, and the refusal prints the region edge and the soft limit it broke

MANUAL/1.evidence: a leased jog moves the turret and expires when keepalives stop arriving

MANUAL/2.evidence: the same test ends by dropping the keepalive and asserting motion stops

MANUAL/4.evidence: a step is a finite move that stops at the commanded offset

MANUAL/6.item_text: Requested/reference/actual motion is visible to operator.
MANUAL/6.evidence: asked / reference / actual are published and drawn side by side, with no pose rendered as zero

COMMON/1.item_text: Exactly one normal operating mode owns motion at a time.
COMMON/1.evidence: across mode switches no intent from the previous mode survives and no impossible joint step appears

COMMON/2.item_text: STOP MOTION always results in MANUAL/HOLD.
COMMON/2.evidence: stop motion ends the sweep and leaves the loop in MANUAL holding

COMMON/3.item_text: Safety/homing/park states override all operating modes.
COMMON/3.evidence: the homing gate refuses a mode that would move an unhomed station, with a reason

COMMON/6.item_text: All mode changes and target changes are logged.
COMMON/6.evidence: mode changes, selection changes and the reacquisition refusal are emitted as §79 events and asserted in the replayed transcript

COMMON/5.item_text: Existing v1 control-loop timing remains within accepted limits.
COMMON/5.evidence: every v3 mode measures p99 <= 4 us in simulation against a 5000 us period; the accepted limits are the pre-v3 measurement on the Pi, which v3 has not yet been held against

AUTO_ROAM/4.evidence: while a sweep runs, ~30 Hz of detector frames keep reaching controld and the candidate list stays populated

AUTO_ROAM/5.evidence: the selected track identifier is asserted unchanged across 1.5 s of sweeping, with frames still arriving

AUTO_ROAM/6.item_text: Roaming does not automatically pursue selected target by default.
AUTO_ROAM/6.evidence: a selected person is left in place and AUTO_ROAM sweeps anyway: no auto_track intent and no los_direction intent appear, and the yaw demonstrably moved

AUTO_ROAM/7.item_text: Switching to AUTO_TRACK acquires selected visible target.
AUTO_ROAM/7.evidence: after a sweep, switching to AUTO_TRACK with no new click reaches ACQUIRE then TRACKING on the surviving selection

MANUAL/3.evidence: the same jog at FINE and FAST differs in the plant, not only in the label: published scale 0.15 against 1.0, and peak yaw speed differs by more than half again

COMMON/4.item_text: No UI/vision process can write motors directly.
COMMON/4.evidence: no web or vision source contains code that opens a CAN or serial device, and the only bus layer on the station lives in control/src/can
